validation: No tests, builds, deployment runs, or syntax checks were executed by this agent. Source inspection used read, grep, and gopls. Main owns execution.
admission: Invoke each driver through the native le job run command below. Supervise long-running invocations with hub start; the native deployment proof owns its daemon and peer processes.
common-prerequisites: Run from the checkout root with the existing native le binary, Bash, jq, GNU timeout, sha256sum, cp, mkdir, uname, and date.
Each output directory must be new. The driver refuses to overwrite it.

Do not set ZE_L2TP_SKIP_KERNEL_PROBE, ze.l2tp.skip-kernel-probe, ZE_PPPOE_SKIP_KERNEL_PROBE, or ze.pppoe.skip-kernel-probe, including values such as false. The native preflights refuse their presence.
Keep the existing Linux 7.2 runtime kernel at tmp/kernel/build/vmlinuz. Select a current native-architecture daemon with ZE_EVIDENCE_ZE_BINARY; the driver does not rebuild either artifact.
A container runs on its Docker daemon's kernel. The host uname file does not prove a remote Docker daemon's kernel version. Record docker info when Docker is remote.

A character device at /dev/ppp; Linux ppp_generic, pppox, l2tp_core, l2tp_netlink, and l2tp_ppp support; a working ip l2tp show tunnel query.
An executable current daemon of the runtime architecture. ZE_EVIDENCE_ZE_BINARY prevents hostDaemon from building another daemon.

expected-success: The L2TP listener and static IPv4 pool start, and xl2tpd establishes an incoming session.
PPP LCP and IPCP complete through the daemon. Kernel PPP interfaces in both namespaces carry opposite local/peer pairs 10.100.0.1 and 10.100.0.2.
The LAC sends two successful ICMP probes to 10.100.0.1 over PPP.
Ze emits the subscriber-route injection observation. This action does not independently verify BGP advertisement.
invocations.expected-rejection: None. The native configuration explicitly uses auth-method none and allow-no-auth true. This invocation proves no credential authentication or rejection.
expected-teardown: The native checker stops xl2tpd before stopping Ze, then observes the subscriber-route withdrawal.
Both namespaces return to their initial PPP-link sets and L2TP tunnel/session snapshots; the specific PPP interfaces disappear.
invocations.proof-limit: No packet capture is retained. Native stderr contains the watched daemon/peer stream; native-report.json records the verdict and interface/address identities.

qemu-l2tp-route.purpose: Run the same l2tp driver on the existing runtime kernel when the workstation cannot provide PPPoL2TP. The native QEMU harness owns boot, SSH setup, runtime-kernel verification, and VM shutdown.
qemu-l2tp-route.command: bin/le-testing-baseline-final/le le job run label baseline-subscriber-l2tp-qemu command bin/le-testing-baseline-final/le le qemu run kernel tmp/kernel/build/vmlinuz packages 'bash coreutils jq xl2tpd ppp iproute2 iputils kmod' timeout 20m command 'cd /workspace && bash tmp/session/2026-09-21-97650314-2770-467e-8578-1739803540cf/scratch/baseline-subscriber/run.sh l2tp tmp/session/2026-09-21-97650314-2770-467e-8578-1739803540cf/scratch/baseline-subscriber/output-l2tp-qemu'
prerequisites: Native QEMU harness prerequisites and package-network access
Existing static Linux amd64 native le and the selected current daemon visible at /workspace
The scratch share must remain visible; do not write evidence under guest tmp/evidence because the QEMU harness mounts that path as tmpfs.
qemu-l2tp-route.pppoe-limit: The Docker lab does not become available merely by entering the Alpine QEMU guest. Main must provide a Docker daemon with the required kernel, or use the separately registered qemu pppoe-accel-test client lab. No mock substitutes are provided.
